review_candidates.title: HR & Operations Specialist
review_candidates.description: About the job HR & Operations Specialist Location: Lithuania / Remote-first  ·  Full-time    About CUBE AI CUBE AI is an Agentic Crime Prevention Platform, built at the intersection of agentic AI, cybersecurity, and fraud prevention. We serve the institutions on the front line of an exploding wave of AI-powered crime: banks, fintechs, and the platforms criminals cannot operate without. Our mission is ambitious: make the world a safer place. How we do it is the part we're most excited about, and the part we're happy to walk you through in a conversation.   Why this is the seat to take This is a rare seat on a rocket ship. CUBE AI is early, exceptionally ambitious, and backed by some of the world's leading investors. Our founders have built and scaled startups to unicorn valuations and exits and have run mega teams at mega companies. We are building the company that puts the institutions the modern economy runs on back on offense against AI-powered crime. The closest analogy is j oining Palantir in its early days: a hard mission, a category we're defining rather than entering, and a small group of exceptional people compounding fast. If you want a comfortable role, this isn't it. If you want the defining chapter of your career, your best work alongside people who make you sharper, keep reading.   The role CUBE AI is looking for a hands-on HR & Operations Specialist to support our people, recruitment, and day-to-day business operations as we scale internationally. This is a broad, practical role spanning the full employee lifecycle — from recruitment and onboarding to day-to-day HR support — alongside the administrative and operational work that keeps a fast-growing international company running smoothly. We’re looking for someone highly organized, proactive, and comfortable taking ownership across a wide range of tasks. As CUBE AI grows, the scope of the role will grow with it. What you'll do Key Responsibilities ·      Manage end-to-end recruitment coordination: job postings, CV screening, interview scheduling, and candidate communication across multiple markets ·      Coordinate onboarding for new hires across multiple jurisdictions, including through our international employment partners ·      Prepare and manage HR documentation, including contracts, offer letters, employment records, and certificates ·      Act as the first point of contact for employees on day-to-day HR questions, including leave, benefits, contracts, and general queries ·      Collaborate with company leadership and external legal counsel on HR matters, employment documentation, policies, and people-related processes ·      Support bonus and incentive processes end-to-end, including calculations, approvals, documentation, and coordination with Finance and payroll providers ·      Coordinate the annual performance review process, working with team leads on timelines, documentation, follow-ups, and implementation of agreed outcomes ·      Support day-to-day office administration and help ensure smooth office operations ·      Organize employee business travel, internal company events, and employee engagement activities ·      Maintain and improve the employee referral program and support employer branding and job posting optimization across markets ·      Help develop, document, implement, and continuously improve HR processes, policies, and workflows as the company scales ·      Work closely with team leads, Finance, and Operations on headcount planning, hiring plans, HR-related budgets, and people-related operational matters ·      Support HR-related documentation and administration for government grants, subsidies, and other company programs, working closely with Finance and Operations What we're looking for The bar: Extreme drive and passion for the work and the mission. Extreme ability to learn fast and operate with confidence in uncertainty. Extreme IQ and EQ. You raise the level of every room, and you lose an argument gracefully the moment someone's right.   For this role specifically: ·      2+ years of experience in HR, People Operations, HR & Office Operations, or a similar hands-on people/operations role ·      Good understanding of core HR processes and the ability to help document, implement, and improve them ·      Familiarity with Lithuanian employment practices; international/EOR experience is a plus ·      Experience supporting recruitment processes; familiarity with applicant-tracking tools is a plus ·      Comfortable working across time zones and with distributed teams ·      Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple stakeholders, priorities, and deadlines ·      Fluent Lithuanian and English (spoken and written) ·      Nice to have: experience in a fast-growth tech or startup environment How we work and who thrives here Our core locations are Lithuania, London, and New York, and we consider remote-first candidates who can travel as needed for their role. We write more than we meet and move at warp speed. We're an AI-first company: every person here is amplified by a layer of AI agents, and we scale capability, not headcount. We don't buy services, we buy results. We're drivers, not passengers, so we hire people who go and do it without waiting for permission. We move fast, and we use judgment where it counts: we hold sensitive data and the trust of the institutions we protect, and we never cut corners there. Our culture runs on five virtues: A pedantic bar for quality. Work that is thorough, complete, and on time. We trust each other to deliver, fully. Radical ownership. See it, own it, fix it. Never defer a problem or an opportunity. You will never be reprimanded for taking initiative. Relentless energy and audacity. Building something exceptional demands enormous energy. We move forward with maximum drive. Automate everything. We scale the capability of our people, not the headcount. We always hunt the 10x multiplier, working alongside AI agents rather than piling on process. Have fun. We work with people we genuinely enjoy. It gets us through the hard stretches and keeps politics out.   What's in it for you Uncapped growth. In a company moving this fast, scope finds the people who can carry it. Ownership and title are earned in months, not years. Real self-realization. This is a place to become the most capable version of yourself, next to people operating at the top of their game. You share in the outcome. When the company wins big, you win big.   What we offer Competitive salary: €3,500–€6,000 gross per month , depending on experience and skills. Join a rocket ship. Let's discuss compensation and the rest of the details on our call. Apply: hr@cube3.ai   CUBE AI is an equal-opportunity employer. We welcome applicants of every background and will support any accommodations you need during the hiring process.

review_candidates.title: Corporate Sales Specialist
review_candidates.description: About USGIS U.S. Global Immigration Services (USGIS), a concern of Shera International Group, is a private immigration advisory firm specializing in business and professional immigration pathways for international entrepreneurs, investors, executives, and organizations. We provide strategy-first guidance on L-1 (business expansion), E-2 (investor visa), and EB-2 NIW (professional immigration) to help clients move their businesses and careers to the United States. As a key operating entity within Shera International Group, USGIS is expanding its corporate client acquisition and account management operations in Bangladesh. We are seeking a top-performing Corporate Sales Specialist to build and maintain relationships with high-value corporate clients, identify immigration-eligible businesses, and drive client onboarding and successful case completion. The Role & Scope This is a results-driven, field-based position reporting to the Sales & Business Development Head. You'll be the primary relationship manager for corporate accounts, responsible for identifying, qualifying, and onboarding Bangladeshi businesses eligible for L-1, E-2, or professional immigration pathways to the USA . You'll act as the first point of contact and ongoing project coordinator, ensuring a seamless client experience from initial consultation through successful visa approval. Core Responsibilities Corporate Account Development: Identify, prospect, and establish relationships with mid-to-large Bangladeshi corporations, business owners, and executives exploring U.S. expansion, investment, or professional opportunities. Client Qualification & Pathway Matching: Assess corporate and individual eligibility for L-1, E-2, or professional immigration pathways. Communicate value propositions clearly and position USGIS services as the trusted advisor. Consultation & Onboarding: Conduct initial consultations, deliver needs assessments, and guide qualified clients through the USGIS intake process. Complete accurate client intake documentation and prepare case summaries for the advisory team. Relationship & Project Management: Serve as the primary account contact throughout the client journey. Manage timelines, coordinate document collection, provide progress updates, and ensure consistent communication. Act as internal project liaison between sales, advisory, and support teams. Business Development & Brand Building: Build USGIS brand presence within target corporate sectors. Attend industry events, business forums, and networking opportunities. Generate referrals and identify strategic partnership channels. Sales Target Execution: Meet or exceed daily meeting targets (5-8 qualified client meetings/week), monthly client onboarding quotas, and annual revenue targets. Track KPIs, maintain accurate CRM records, and report weekly progress. Follow-Up & Relationship Nurturing: Conduct consistent follow-up with prospects, handle objections professionally, and maintain long-term relationships with past clients. Cross-sell additional USGIS services where appropriate. Minimum Qualifications Experience: 2-6 years of professional sales, business development, or account management experience. Prior experience in immigration, legal services, consulting, or B2B enterprise sales is strongly preferred. Corporate Sales Track Record: Proven ability to close B2B deals, manage high-value accounts, and achieve consistent monthly/quarterly sales targets. Evidence of success in enterprise or consultancy sales environments. Bangladesh Market Knowledge: In-depth understanding of Bangladeshi business landscape, corporate ecosystem, and entrepreneurial mindset. Fluent in Bengali and English (verbal and written). Immigration/Visa Awareness: Strong foundational understanding of U.S. business immigration concepts (L-1, E-2 visas). Ability to explain pathways clearly to corporate clients. Willingness to deepen expertise through USGIS training. Interpersonal Excellence: Exceptional communication skills, professional demeanor, and ability to build trust and rapport with C-suite executives, business owners, and mid-level managers. Self-Motivated: Results-driven, target-focused, and comfortable with performance-based compensation tied directly to client onboarding and successful case outcomes. Preferred Qualifications Prior sales experience in immigration law, consulting, financial services, or enterprise software/SaaS Bachelor's degree in Business, Economics, Commerce, or related field Active relationships/network within Bangladeshi corporate, startup, or business owner communities Experience with CRM systems (HubSpot, Salesforce, Pipedrive) Familiarity with U.S. business expansion trends or foreign direct investment (FDI) Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) Activity Targets: 25-40 qualified corporate client meetings per month; 5-8 meetings per week Onboarding Targets: 6-10 new client engagements onboarded per month; 80+ annually Case Success: Track and support clients through approval milestones; aim for a 70%+ successful case completion rate Revenue Generation: Achieve monthly revenue targets through per-client onboarding fees and service completion bonuses Relationship Quality: Maintain 80%+ client satisfaction; generate 3-5 qualified referrals monthly Compensation Structure Base Salary: Competitive salary commensurate with experience (negotiable based on background) Monthly target bonus (if targets exceeded) Benefits: Professional development support, performance recognition, career growth into leadership roles Required Working Conditions Location: Dhaka-based; office presence required for client meetings, team collaboration, and business development activities Travel: 20-30% domestic travel within Bangladesh for client meetings and corporate networking events Hours: Standard business hours (10 AM–6 PM, Saturday–Thursday) with flexibility for client meetings and evening/weekend engagement as needed Daily Engagement: Minimum 5-8 client meetings or qualified prospects contacted daily; documented in CRM by end of business day Reporting: Daily/Weekly progress reports to Sales Head; monthly KPI reviews; quarterly business development strategy sessions Why Join USGIS High-Growth Organization: Be part of a scaling immigration advisory firm with expanding corporate client base and increasing market demand Performance-Based Rewards: Unlimited earning potential through client onboarding fees and case completion bonuses — top performers earn significantly above base salary Professional Development: In-depth training on U.S. immigration pathways, corporate consulting, and sales excellence from experienced immigration advisors Corporate Impact: Help successful Bangladeshi businesses expand globally, and executives pursue international opportunities; directly impact client success stories Entrepreneurial Culture: Work in a dynamic, results-focused environment where individual initiative and business acumen are rewarded Career Trajectory: Clear pathway to Account Management Director, Sales Manager, or Business Development Head roles based on performance Equal Opportunity Employer Shera International Group is an Equal Opportunity Employer committed to building a diverse and inclusive team.
